computePD_PDControllerStable: compute stable PD control forces for a PyBullet rigid body using joint states and desired positions
computePD_PDControllerStableMultiDof: compute stable PD control forces for a multi-DOF PyBullet body including base position and orientation
create_PDControllerStable: create a PDControllerStable instance with a PyBullet client to compute stable proportional-derivative controller forces
create_PDControllerStableMultiDof: create a PDControllerStableMultiDof instance with a PyBullet client to control multi-DOF joints and base pose
refactor_computePD: refactor the computePD method to support custom inertia matrix computation or alternative Coriolis force estimation
